EZFIRELICS-PROTEIN_POWDER.title: Protein Powder
EZFIRELICS-PROTEIN_POWDER.description: Before your turn, halve your [gold]Frail[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold].
EZFIRELICS-HOLE_IN_ONE_CLUB.title: Hole In One Club
EZFIRELICS-HOLE_IN_ONE_CLUB.description: If you achieve victory on your [blue]1st[/blue] turn, gain [blue]{MaxHP}[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold].
EZFIRELICS-HOLE_IN_ONE_CLUB.flavor: For when par isn't good enough.
EZFIRELICS-SNECKO_DICE.title: Snecko Dice
EZFIRELICS-BLOODY_BLADE.title: Bloody Sword
EZFIRELICS-BLOODY_BLADE.description: When an enemy goes under half HP, inflict [blue]{VulnAmount}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
EZFIRELICS-BLOODY_BLADE.flavor: The blood is still fresh, but you don't know who's it is.
EZFIRELICS-FAX_MACHINE.title: Fax Machine
EZFIRELICS-FAX_MACHINE.description: Card rewards will have an extra option from other colors.
EZFIRELICS-SCALPEL.title: Scalpel
EZFIRELICS-SCALPEL.description: At the start of your turn, exhaust an unplayable card in your hand. If you do, draw [blue]{CardDraw}[/blue] card.
EZFIRELICS-SCALPEL.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose an unplayable card to exhaust.
EZFIRELICS-LOVELY_LOCKET.title: Lovely Locket
EZFIRELICS-LOVELY_LOCKET.description: Give a Power [gold]Innate[/gold] and increase its cost by [blue]1[/blue].
EZFIRELICS-LOVELY_LOCKET.flavor: They say keeping the locket close to your heart will protect you from evil.
EZFIRELICS-LONG_TOOTH.title: Long Tooth
EZFIRELICS-LONG_TOOTH.flavor: A tooth from an unknown animal you don't want to meet.
EZFIRELICS-GRANDFATHER_CLOCK.title: Grandfather Clock
EZFIRELICS-GRANDFATHER_CLOCK.description: On your [blue]{ActivateTurn}th[/blue] turn, the first [blue]{NumOfCards}[/blue] cards you play cost [blue]0[/blue].
EZFIRELICS-GRANDFATHER_CLOCK.flavor: Complete with a little wooden bird that sings on the hour.
EZFIRELICS-HEAVY_SHIELD.title: Heavy Shield
EZFIRELICS-HEAVY_SHIELD.description: Each turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to half the highest enemy [gold]Block[/gold].
EZFIRELICS-HEAVY_SHIELD.flavor: It's a pain to carry around, but nothing's getting through it.
EZFIRELICS-LEAKING_BATTERY.title: Leaking Battery
EZFIRELICS-LEAKING_BATTERY.description: At the end of your turn, [blue]{DamageAmount}[/blue] damage to a random enemy for each unspent [gold]Energy[/gold].
EZFIRELICS-GUN.title: Gen 1 Glock 17 9mm Pistol
EZFIRELICS-GUN.description: If an Attack does [blue]{MinDamage}[/blue]+ damage, double it.
EZFIRELICS-VAMPIRE_DENTURES.title: Vampire Dentures
EZFIRELICS-VAMPIRE_DENTURES.description: When you overkill an enemy by [blue]{OverkillAmount}[/blue]+ HP, heal [blue]{HealAmount}[/blue] HP.
EZFIRELICS-OVERFLOWING_CUP.title: Overflowing Cup
EZFIRELICS-OVERFLOWING_CUP.description: Overkill damage is dealt to a random enemy.
EZFIRELICS-OVERFLOWING_CUP.flavor: Always spills when you try to move it.
